description: Search currently active, reviewed, publicly listed Hirehouse roles. Every word in `query` must match the role's title, company, location or description. If nothing matches, related roles are returned instead with match: "related". Supports location, work mode, compensation, featured, recency, and sort filters. Results are public listings only.

featuredOnly.description: Whether to return only featured public roles

hasPayRange.description: Whether the role must have an advertised pay range

location.description: City, country, or location text from the public listing

postedWithinDays.description: Only roles published within this many days

query.description: Words from the role title, skills, company, or location, e.g. "backend engineer dubai"

name: search_jobs
title: Search HireHouse jobs
